name: fitweb-gate-mainroad-1
prompt: Edit this image and keep everything already in it exactly the same: the camera, framing, the gate canopy, the left guard block with its glass cabin, the FIT logo and copper plaque, the right pillar with the Forteasia logo, the canopy lettering FORTEASIA INDUSTRIAL TOWNSHIP, the single red-and-white boom barrier at the guard cabin (exactly one barrier, add no other barrier or pole), the working factory on the LEFT, the navy warehouse, the internal roads and median behind the gate, the container truck, tipper truck, pickup, forklift, flags, workers, grass, walls, colours and soft light. Make these changes, built as a miniature scale model in exactly the same style as the rest: 1) A MAIN ROAD OUTSIDE THE GATE: in the foreground, in front of the gate (the side nearest the camera, outside the township), add a wide public main road, four lanes with a thin central divider, white dashed lane markings and kerbs, running straight across the whole image from the far left edge to the far right edge, perpendicular to the entry road. The two lanes of the entry road that come out of the gate meet this main road in a clean T-junction, with curved turning lanes and turn arrows on both sides, so a truck leaving the gate can turn left or right onto the main road. Both ends of the main road fade softly into the beige background, never a hard cut. Put one or two small vehicles driving on the main road, staying in their lanes. 2) A WAREHOUSE on the RIGHT side of the image, inside the township, on the empty beige area to the right of the entry road and behind the right Forteasia pillar, with its own paved yard connected to the internal road: a long logistics warehouse with a navy and light-grey ribbed metal facade, a low pitched roof with skylights, a row of loading docks with roller shutters, two open with warm light inside, a container truck parked at a dock, pallets, a forklift, a few tiny workers in hi-vis vests and a few trees. It sits firmly on the ground at the same scale as the factory, not floating. No text or logos on the new buildings or roads, no watermark.
